identity: A thread of ten reader comments posted under Arabic news articles (Al Jazeera / Arabic-forum register): Syrian Alawite politics, an Aramco accident, Hamas, war memories in Lebanon, Palestinian factional thuggery, Egypt's army, a Somali/Puntland tribal spat, and an angry word to arms-dealers. Each <NL> ends one commenter's post. Exactly the genre of doc_616eaaa0cc9d (doctrine 0y).
law: Median printed line = 50 tokens, so PROSE MODE. But the native unit here is the loose-speech utterance, and 0y says it is COARSE: 1-4 units per comment, ~15-20 tokens each. A cut is earned only by a genuinely new proposition/speech act. Subordinators and explanatory f (0p/0q), anaphoric back-reference, masdar chains (0t), result connectives (lidhalik), amma-contrast and pious tags (1b) all stay INSIDE the unit. Address headers (radd ala l-akh, ila l-akh raqm 1, kalima li-kull man) merge FORWARD into the sentence they introduce - direct precedent: doc_616eaaa0cc9d 'akhi al-karim inna al-ayn la-tadma' merged.
reasoning: @14 waa'lamu = imperative + new addressee after a complete statement -> new speech act, cut; @24 wa-ana bi-intizar = new agent + new topic (waiting for an uprising), cut. @52 the accident-is-fate claim ends; wa-sharikat Aramco introduces a NEW subject and topic -> cut, but wa-hasalat ala l-jawa'iz elaborates the SAME topic (Aramco's record) -> merge (0j/1d). @68 wa-indama is a fronted temporal frame: cut BEFORE it, never after (0n/0x). Comment 3 (@78-123) is one long sentence: the relative clause and the masdars wa-inkar / wa-l-luju' are sub-clausal (0t) -> ONE unit, 46 tokens. Comment 4: 'ya'ni' explicitly ties the pious exclamation la hawla wa-la quwwa back to what follows as one breath, so I did NOT cut at @130 (also 1b: never open a unit with a formula); wallahi shay' yuqhar is an evaluative coda that closes its unit -> boundary AFTER it @149; then the scenes-clause and the reported speech and the sarcastic 'tayyib' each start fresh. Comment 5: I refused three tempting cuts - fa-huwa yuharib (explanatory f, 0m), wa-kull hadhihi al-ma'ani (anaphoric comment, 0q), li-dhalik fa-hum (result connective, C3) - and cut only at @206 where 'yastati' al-mujrim' opens a brand-new asyndetic topic. Comment 6: @239 the nominal headline 'intifada jadida wa-min naw' mustahdath' stands alone before the fa-narrative; @260 wa-l-sabab gives the cause as a fresh statement; @273 turns from statement to supplication; I did NOT split the two du'as at @281 - one closing prayer block. Comment 7: amma X attaches to the statement it contrasts with (F5), but here it opens the counter-proposal after a complete rhetorical question, and the following PP fragment 'fi ghayr ma difa'' is an afterthought qualification, not a new sentence -> single cut @316; the closing wafaqa allah al-jami' rides backward (1b). Comment 8: lakin + idha...fa is one sentence (0q) all the way to @371; then wa-la sabil li-l-istiqrar is the new proposition, with wa-tashrik (masdar, 0t) and thumma taqa' iqamat al-hujja (same topic, 0u) riding inside it. Comment 9: question + its own answer = ONE unit (C4), so no cut at @404 and the address header merges too; @412/@432/@441 mark imperative, speech-verb (E3) and closing du'a; I refused @423 because wa-lawla elaborates the same security point. Comment 10: 'kalima li-kull man...' treated identically to the other two address headers (0s: a repeated pattern must be segmented identically) -> merged forward; hasbi allah wa-ni'ma al-wakil attaches backward (1b) so the boundary is @481 not @477. Mean unit = 17 tokens, inside the prose sanity band.
